Major Japanese medical device manufacturers include global leaders like [Olympus](https://www.reuters.com/business/japans-olympus-says-moving-asset-sales-towards-doing-deals-2022-11-15/) (endoscopy and surgical tech), [Terumo](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/investing/markets/stocks/TRUMF/pressreleases/3330261/terumo-issues-long-term-stock-options-to-align-executives-with-shareholders/) (cardiovascular systems), [Sysmex](https://www.businessdailyafrica.com/bd/corporate/health/japanese-healthcare-giant-opens-office-in-nairobi-5112380) (hematology diagnostics), [Omron](https://www.lazada.sg/tag/omron-blood-pressure-monitor-japan/) (home health monitors), and [Nipro](https://www.nsmedicaldevices.com/analysis/biggest-needle-syringe-manufacturers-companies/) (renal and hospital supplies), alongside major imaging and tech conglomerates like Canon, Fujifilm, and Hoya. [](https://www.proclinical.com/blogs/2020-11/who-are-the-top-medical-device-manufacturers-in-japan-2020)

- **Olympus:** Dominates the global gastrointestinal endoscope market and builds advanced surgical visualization systems.

- **Terumo:** Specializes in cardiovascular surgery, catheter technologies, and blood management products.

- **Sysmex:** A worldwide leader in clinical laboratory testing, specifically hematology and urinalysis

- **Omron:** Well-known globally for consumer and clinical blood pressure monitors and nebulizers.

- **Nipro:** Manufactures medical-surgical products, artificial kidneys, and injection/infusion systems.

- **Nihon Kohden:** Focuses on patient monitors, electroencephalographs (EEGs), and cardiology diagnostic equipment.

- **Canon Medical Systems & Fujifilm:** Major players providing diagnostic imaging solutions like CT, MRI, ultrasound, and X-ray systems. [](https://www.proclinical.com/blogs/2020-11/who-are-the-top-medical-device-manufacturers-in-japan-2020)
